stem: Bruno needs a better topic sentence for the second paragraph (sentences 5–9). Which sentence can BEST replace sentence 5 to help Bruno accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: If you’ve done any online shopping, you are probably accustomed to seeing companies ask customers to leave a review.

options.label: B
options.text: Generally speaking, loyal customers are ones who come back to the same company for multiple purchases.

options.label: C
options.text: These days, there are many ways a customer can shop for needed items both online and in person.

options.label: D
options.text: First and foremost, an honest and fair online review helps potential customers who are trying to make a purchasing decision.
